column3: As before, you must first stipulate the qualities you seek from your armament.
Now I shall replicate the martial memories and meld them with your phantom weapon...
A martial master's vivid memories from the heat o' battle, blended with the finest craftsmanship in the bleedin' realm... An' not a trace of illusory magicks to constrain its potential!
Yer 's the pinnacle o' war-wagin' perfection!
Yer  an'  are the pinnacle o' war-wagin' perfection!
Not much else we can do here at the forge. It's time ye took yer weapon out there an' made a new set o' martial memories!
Oh, if ye feel the need to tinker with it again, it'll cost ye a chunk of ecliptic arcanite. Got it?
Speak with Brigid in the phantom village if you wish to readjust the attributes of your phantom weapon.
The chunks of ecliptic arcanite required for readjustment can be obtained from Ermina, who is also stationed in the phantom village.
